system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Sends OTP for cold storage service authentication. For your information, my mobile_number is 9876595331, my aadhaar_number is 100020006513.

function.name: coldstorage_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for cold storage service authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

function.name: coldstorage_submit_application
function.description: Submits an application for cold storage/cluster infrastructure support. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate application, or incomplete project details.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.
